reviews.t: Gorgeous bows in every color you will ever need
reviews.x: I love putting these headbands on my baby girl! They come in so many colors that it's easy to find something to match every item of clothing in her wardrobe. The double bow detailing is so adorable and unique, and I love the high quality grosgrain ribbon. The ends are sealed so they won't fray either. You can't go wrong purchasing these beautiful ribbon headbands!

I absolutely LOVE these! They are in perfect condition. Every color is perfectly shown. The bows are secure to the elastic band and the band even fits around my head, so this is good for ALL ages. Wonderful price and i was really impressed with this product. I am so glad i don't need to spend $9 on 2 bows now. ♡
At the price I was expecting them to be poor quality they are not. They are large for a newborn but my daughter is growing in to them at 2.5 months

Other than that the other colors were very pretty and fit perfectly on my daug

reviews.t: Great quality hairbands in 20 colors at the price you can't beat!
reviews.x: The boughs are not too big, not too small, just right, and the colors will go with every outfit my daughter has. The elastic band is soft and long enough to go around my 3 y.o.large head without being too tight, unlike some other headbands we have. The items appear to be made well. Have to see how they stand up to washing. The shipping from China was also surprisingly fast - 9 days only!

I ordered these headbands for my 2.5 month old, and they arrived in 9 days from when I ordered! (They weren't expected to arrive for another month!) They arrived in perfect condition and they fit my little girl just right! They are exactly as they are advertised!! Very happy with the quality, price, and quick arrival!

reviews.t: These bows are super cute and a great size
reviews.x: These bows are super cute and a great size. However, I did not receive 20 bows I only received 18, my pack was  missing the navy blue and the light blue. I wish I would have received all 20 bows like in the description. I'm only giving it 3 stars because I did not receive my full order.

I don't regret buying these at all ! The quality is amazing and you literally get every color you see. You can not go wrong with the price the plus is it doesn't have that hard dry glue on the back of the bow that's usually in other bows that leave the baby's head a red mark.

reviews.t: I am so happy with my bows
reviews.x: I am so happy with my bows! They are bright and fun, just like I wanted! They came on time and to make it even better the bows were packaged nicely so they werent scrunched or wrinkled!
Omg the colors are amazing ! There's a bow for almost every outfit . Fits my 5 month old perfect with room to grow . I was happy for days just mix and maxing her outfits with the bows .

reviews.t: Not durable. Fashion only. Do not wash!
reviews.x: They are very cute, but not durable at all. They completely come apart if you have to wash them in the washer. Used cold water even and it broke them to shreds. 😢
All of the bows were in horrible shape! I was so disappointed! Every single bow had something wrong with it. It was either cut weird or had glue all over them.
I bought these for my 1 month old and they are better than expected! There is a color to match every outfit and they are high quality at a great price!

reviews.t: Great quality and perfect size for my 15 month old
reviews.x: These headbands were exactly what I wanted! Great quality and perfect size for my 15 month old!!!! Very pleased!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wide variety of colors, saying there is a bow to match any outfit.
Many customers consider the product a great value for the price.
Several reviewers report the bows fit well and work across a range of ages, from babies to older children.
Some customers mention glue on the bows, though opinions differ on whether it is a minor issue or a sign of poor quality.
A few reviewers complain about slow shipping and receiving incorrect colors or clips instead of headbands.
